name: Veralto
description: Veralto sells the instruments, chemicals and software that measure and treat water and that mark, code and design product packaging. About 61% of its sales are recurring (consumables such as reagents and inks, spare parts, services and software), because each installed instrument or printer keeps pulling in refills and service. Water Quality (Hach, Trojan Technologies, ChemTreat) sells to municipal utilities and industrial plants; Product Quality & Innovation (Videojet, Linx, Esko, X-Rite, Pantone) sells to consumer-goods, food and pharmaceutical makers. Despite the Industrials / Environmental Services label it is mostly an installed-base instruments-and-consumables company with a 59.9% gross margin, not a waste or facilities-services business.

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Industrials' and Sub-Industry 'Environmental & Facilities Services' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30). That list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 3825 (Instruments for Measuring & Testing of Electricity & Electrical Signals) per EDGAR.

hq.note: 225 Wyman Street, Suite 250, Waltham, MA 02451 (FY2025 10-K cover)

employees.note: "Nearly 17,000" employees (FY2025 10-K): about 6,500 North America, 5,000 Western Europe, 500 other developed markets, 5,000 high-growth markets; about 16,500 full-time and 500 part-time. Exact count not given.

businessLines.name: Water Quality (WQ)
businessLines.how: Customers buy analytical instruments and treatment equipment once, then repeatedly buy reagents, consumables, service and software for them; ChemTreat sells treatment chemicals and on-site programmes to industrial customers on an ongoing basis.
businessLines.description: Water analytics (Hach), UV disinfection and filtration (Trojan Technologies) and industrial water treatment chemicals and programmes (ChemTreat), sold to municipal and industrial water users.

revenue.note: FY2024 $3,138M; FY2023 $3,039M; up 5.9% in 2025, core sales up 4.7% (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1967680/000196768026000011/vlto-20251231.htm)

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2024 $3,138M; FY2023 $3,039M; up 5.9% in 2025, core sales up 4.7% (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1967680/000196768026000011/vlto-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: Product Quality & Innovation (PQI)
businessLines.how: Brand owners buy printers and software licences or subscriptions, then keep buying inks, solvents and service for the installed printers; software (Esko, TraceGains) is sold as licences or SaaS.
businessLines.description: Marking and coding (Videojet, Linx; printers and consumables), packaging design and workflow software (Esko, TraceGains), colour measurement (X-Rite) and the Pantone colour standard.

revenue.note: FY2024 $2,055M; FY2023 $1,982M; up 6.2% in 2025, core sales up 4.8% (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1967680/000196768026000011/vlto-20251231.htm)

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2024 $2,055M; FY2023 $1,982M; up 6.2% in 2025, core sales up 4.8% (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1967680/000196768026000011/vlto-20251231.htm)

brands.name: Hach
brands.note: Best known WQ brand; over 149,000 customers, helps ensure safe water for more than 3.4 billion people. Brand-level revenue not disclosed.

brands.name: Trojan Technologies
brands.note: UV and membrane filtration; treats about 15 trillion gallons a year. Revenue not disclosed.

brands.name: ChemTreat
brands.note: Industrial water treatment chemicals and programmes. Revenue not disclosed.

brands.name: In-Situ
brands.note: Acquired Jan 22, 2026 for about $427M net of cash. Revenue not disclosed.

brands.name: Videojet and Linx
brands.note: Videojet is the largest operating company in PQI. Revenue not disclosed.

brands.name: Esko and TraceGains
brands.note: Packaging design software (over 25,000 customers in 140+ countries); TraceGains cloud compliance software acquired 2024.

brands.name: X-Rite and Pantone
brands.note: X-Rite serves over 13,000 brands and suppliers; Pantone is the colour standard.
